# State Class View (variant): Drinking water programme analyst (state)

> **Not a classification basis / not a job analysis / not for RIF or rating decisions.**
>
> Task importance, time share, critical and needed-at-entry values are agent drafts (raterType llm, validationStatus draft, evidence S): assessment pending (job analysis). They are not job-analysis results and no human has reviewed them. Target levels are editorial design drafts. A credential gate is shown only when its issuer is verified with a cited source; the other gates are counted, not shown, until the issuer is verified (CR-CP-001 C7).

- **Role:** Drinking water programme analyst (`emst:water/ROL-J624S6K`, P2); authority position (editorial): regulator
- **Generated:** pipelines/views/state_class_view.py@0.2.0, rule state-class-view@0.1.0 (registered rule, status active), as of 2026-10-23

## Mapped classes

No class is mapped in the pilot jurisdictions (TX, WA and PA (state), Lewis County WA (county environmental health), Philadelphia Water Department (municipal utility)). The role's targets below are what a jurisdiction would crosswalk its own class specification against.

## Competency targets by role level (editorial draft target levels, agent-drafted)

- Assure public water system compliance with drinking water requirements — journey L2, senior L3
- Operate within, or oversee, delegated and assumed regulatory programs — journey L2, senior L3
- Conduct regulatory compliance inspections — journey L2, senior L3
- Provide compliance and technical assistance to regulated entities and local governments — journey L2, senior L3
- Track regulatory change and translate it into operating guidance — journey L2, senior L3
- Communicate environmental and health risks under uncertainty — journey L2, senior L3
- Administer environmental financial assistance to local governments — journey L2, senior L3
- Build and maintain a defensible administrative record — journey L2, senior L3
- Investigate and manage emerging contaminants across media — journey L2, senior L3
- Collect trace-level and genetic environmental samples without contamination — journey L1, senior L2
- Interpret and question environmental data products in everyday work — journey L1, senior L1
- Use AI tools responsibly in everyday environmental work — journey L1, senior L1
- Validate AI-generated work products before professional use — journey L1, senior L1
- Record provenance and AI involvement in work products — journey L1, senior L1
